latestVersion.changelog:
Best Editor 1.0.0 — initial release.

- Edit raw video footage into polished clips using a cloud-based AI backend.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB; exports in 1080p MP4.
- Handles token-based authentication and session management automatically.
- Offers fast cloud GPU rendering (1-2 minutes per video) with simple, intent-based commands for common editing tasks.
- Integrated credit management and clear guidance for errors and export limitations.
